Titration of acetic acid with NaOH

Constants: Ka = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵ (pKa = 4.74) and Kw = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴ at 25 °C.

At the start, [H⁺] = √(Ka × C) = √(1.8×10⁻⁵ × 0.100) = 1.34×10⁻³ mol L⁻¹, so pH = 2.87.

In the buffer region we use the Henderson–Hasselbalch equation, pH = pKa + log([A⁻]/[HA]).

| Volume of NaOH (mL) | pH |
|---|---|
| 0.0 | 2.87 |
| 12.5 | 4.74 |
| 25.0 | 8.72 |
| 30.0 | 11.96 |

The equivalence point is at 25.0 mL, pH ≈ 8.72.
